# Read dataset 
```{r}

# Load the data
data1 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Cp_wolb_Europe.csv"), sep=",", header = TRUE))

# Plot Cp
data_long <- data1 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Cp_rep"), 
               names_to = "Replicate", 
               values_to = "Cp")

ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Strain, y = Cp)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~Replicate, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +  # Creates four facets
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Strain", y = "Cp", title = "Cp for RP49 (two upper facets) and ftsZ (two lower facets)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

# Count Wolbachia titer
```{r}

#Calculate mean Cp for two replicates
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(RP49_mean = rowMeans(subset (data1, select = c(Cp_rep1,Cp_rep2)))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(ftsZ_mean = rowMeans(subset (data1, select = c(Cp_rep3,Cp_rep4))))

#Calculate titer (Pfaffi et al, 2001, Hague et al, 2020)
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Titer = 2^(RP49_mean-ftsZ_mean))

#Add CI phenotype
data1$CI <- as.factor(ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Trento", "Bal"), "High CI",
                         ifelse(data1$Strain %in% c("Par6","Rennes", "Am^Bal","Am^Trento", "Am^Par6",  "Am^Rennes"), "Undetectable CI", NA)))

data1 <- data1 %>%
dplyr:: mutate(Strain = factor(Strain, levels = c("Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes","Am^Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Par6",  "Am^Rennes")))

```
# Calculate mean titer and confidence intervals

```{r}
# Count mean titer for replicates
data_mean <-  data1 |>
  dplyr::group_by(Strain) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_titer = mean(Titer),
    sd_titer   = sd(Titer),
    n          = dplyr::n(),
    se         = sd_titer / sqrt(n),
    t_crit     = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low     = mean_titer - t_crit * se,
    ci_high    = mean_titer + t_crit * se
  )

data_mean <- data_mean |>
  dplyr::left_join(data1 |> dplyr::distinct(Strain, CI), by = "Strain")

#Add mean titer to the database
data1 <- data1 |>
  dplyr::left_join(data_mean %>% dplyr::select(Strain, mean_titer, ci_low, ci_high), by = "Strain")
  
 ## Export file with mean titer and confidence intervals values
write.table(x = data_mean, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Mean_titer.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```
                      
# Difference between four lines naturallu infected with Wolbachia
```{r}

#Filter only naturally infected lines
data2 <- data1 |>
  dplyr::filter(Strain %in% c("Bal", "Trento", "Par6","Rennes"))

## Overall difference among lines
m <- lm(log10(Titer) ~ Strain, data = data2)
anova(m)

## Check model assumptions
par(mfrow = c(2,2)); plot(m); par(mfrow = c(1,1))

p_diag <- ggplotify::as.ggplot(function() {
  graphics::par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
  graphics::plot(m)
})

cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", "model_diagnostics_titers.pdf"),
                   p_diag, base_height = 13.5/cm(1),
                   base_width = 16/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

## Pairwise comparisons, back-transformed to fold differences

library(emmeans)
em <- emmeans(m, ~ Strain, type = "response")
em
pw <- pairs(em, adjust = "tukey")
tab_pw <- merge(as.data.frame(summary(pw)),
                as.data.frame(confint(pw))[, c("contrast", "lower.CL", "upper.CL")],
                by = "contrast", sort = FALSE)

write.csv2(tab_pw, here::here("data", "derived_data", "titer_pairwise.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```
                      
# Figure with titers for Europe
```{r}
  

# Add information about CI level
data2 <- data2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    CI_low  = c(Trento = 0.43, Bal = 0.67, Par6 = 0,    Rennes = 0   )[as.character(Strain)],
    CI_high = c(Trento = 0.47, Bal = 0.70, Par6 = 0.19, Rennes = 0.18)[as.character(Strain)]
  )

# Labels
labs_x <- with(unique(data2[, c("Strain", "CI_low", "CI_high")]),
               setNames(sprintf("%s\n(%d\u2013%d%%)", Strain,
                                round(CI_low * 100), round(CI_high * 100)), Strain))
##Plot Fig 3

p <- ggplot(data2, aes(x = Strain, y = Titer, colour = CI)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_titer), size = 6, shape = 16) +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("Trento","Bal"), c("Trento","Par6")),
                        annotations = c("*","*"),
                        y_position = c(100, 110),
                        textsize = 6, colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("High CI" = "#DD3497", "Undetectable CI" = "#54278F"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = labs_x) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(italic("Wolbachia")~"titer in testes")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.line            = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks           = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.title.y         = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text            = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    legend.position      = c(0.99, 0.99),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.background    = element_blank(),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin          = margin(6, 8, 6, 6)
  )
p



#Save the plot
title_plot <- "Fig3_titers3.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   p, base_height = 13.5/cm(1),
                   base_width = 16/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

```

# Correlation between hatch rate in test cross and Wolbachia density

```{r}

#Load hatch rate data from zero-inflated model
data2 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confint2_Europe.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

data2 <- data2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

data2 <- data2 |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

data2 <- data2 |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "AmxTrento", "AmxPar6","AmxRennes"))
  
# Merge mean density and median hatch rate
data_density <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data_mean %>% dplyr::select(Strain, mean_titer, ci_low, ci_high, CI), by = c("infstrain" = "Strain"))

#Plot a correlation
pTit <- ggplot(data_density, aes(x = mean_titer, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = CI), size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +  # Points colored by CI status
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = ci_low,
      xmax = ci_high,
      color = CI
    ),
    height = 0.02,   # thickness of horizontal bars
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # Vertical error bars for hatch rate (y)
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = X2.5.,
      ymax = X97.5.,
      color = CI
    ),
    width = 1.7,    # width of the "cap" on vertical bars
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = data_density |> dplyr::filter(!infstrain %in% c("Par6", "Rennes")), aes(label = infstrain), color = "black", alpha = 0.7, size = 5, nudge_x = 7, nudge_y = 0.05, show.legend = FALSE, segment.color = NA) +
ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = data_density |> dplyr::filter(infstrain == "Par6"), aes(label = infstrain), color = "black", alpha = 0.7, size = 5, nudge_x = -5, nudge_y = 0.05, show.legend = FALSE, segment.color = NA) +
ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = data_density |> dplyr::filter(infstrain == "Rennes"), aes(label = infstrain), color = "black", alpha = 0.7, size = 5, nudge_x = 8, nudge_y = 0.05, show.legend = FALSE, segment.color = NA) +
  #ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = infstrain, color = "black"),size = 5, nudge_x = 7, nudge_y = 0.05, show.legend = FALSE, segment.color = NA) +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x = 0.1, label.y = 0.9) +  # Spearman correlation coefficient
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CI" = "sienna1", "no CI" = "yellow3")) +  # Custom colors
  labs(
    x = expression(italic("Wolbachia")~" titer"),
    y = "Hatch rate in test cross (CI strength)",
    color = "CI status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

#Save the plot
title_plot <- "Figure_3_titers.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   pTit, base_height = 13.5/cm(1),
                   base_width = 16/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

#Save mean Wolbachia titer estimation
write.table(x = data_density, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Wolb_mean_titer.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

#Check the correlation

corr<- cor.test(x=1:4,y=1:4, method = "pearson")
cor.test(data_density$mean_titer, data_density$Estimate, method = "pearson", exact = FALSE)

```
